text: what the hell why is this pulling in the studio editor from hmsc-int ? remove that entirely. this is NOT what was asked of you
resolution: Removed the incorrect hmsc-int Studio editor dependency from editor model tabs. ModelDocumentSurface no longer imports StudioEditor, studioOpenModel, or useEffect side effects for studio models; model documents now stay on the ModelView/data path when mesh/path data exists and otherwise fall back to the existing read-only data surface. Verified no cart/editor references to StudioEditor/studiokit remain, and SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor passes with the smaller bundle.
